sequence_description: Brokered SAML login: attempt to authenticate with an expired SAML Assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past). If accepted, Casdoor consumed a different semantic proof than it verified (or skipped time validity checks). Includes a control SAML login with a non-expired assertion.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attack_saml_expired_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attack_saml_expired_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past), indicating proof integrity failure on temporal validity semantics.

sequence_description: I1 proof-integrity check via SAML OneTimeUse semantics: replay the exact same SAML Assertion/@ID (fixed_assertion_id) with OneTimeUse present. If Casdoor accepts the replay, it is consuming a proof instance that should have been invalidated after first use (semantic mismatch between verified proof constraints and consumed proof). Includes two distinct upstream principals to satisfy multi-identity requirement.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_bob_saml_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_bob_saml_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted a replayed SAML assertion with OneTimeUse and identical Assertion/@ID (fixed_assertion_id), indicating it consumed a proof instance that should have been invalidated after first use (proof integrity failure).

sequence_description: Replay the exact same SAML Assertion ID with OneTimeUse across two different upstream principals; SP should reject the second use (anti-replay).
description:
Assertion FAILED: bob_replay_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: bob_replay_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replay of a OneTimeUse SAML Assertion ID (should be rejected on second use).

sequence_description: Attempt SAML assertion replay when temporal Conditions are omitted; then run a control SAML login with normal Conditions to ensure the app/provider path works.
description:
Assertion FAILED: replay2_replay_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: replay2_replay_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replay of the same SAML Assertion ID when Conditions were omitted (should still be rejected as replay).

sequence_description: SAML OneTimeUse replay across two separate login attempts with different state values. If Casdoor does not enforce OneTimeUse/Assertion ID replay protection, the second login may succeed even though the assertion instance was already consumed.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_saml_first_login_status == 200 AND user_attacker_saml_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: (user_attacker_saml_first_login_status=200 == 200 → True) AND (user_attacker_saml_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False)
Implication: Casdoor accepted a replay of a OneTimeUse SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID) on the second login attempt.

sequence_description: Test whether Casdoor prevents replay of the exact same SAML Assertion/@ID when the assertion omits OneTimeUse (should still be rejected as a replayed artifact). Uses two distinct upstream principals to ensure replay is detected by assertion instance, not by principal.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_saml_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_saml_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted a replayed SAML Assertion/@ID (without OneTimeUse), indicating missing anti-replay protection for assertion instances.

sequence_description: Test whether a previously accepted SAML assertion can be replayed after global logout (logout_all=true). Even if sessions are revoked, the original SAML assertion instance must not be accepted again.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_saml_replay_after_logout_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_saml_replay_after_logout_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted a replayed SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID with OneTimeUse) after logout_all, suggesting replay cache is cleared/reset incorrectly.

sequence_description: I2 freshness: attempt login with an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past). Include a control SAML login with a non-expired assertion to prove the SAML path/app/provider is functional in the same run.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_saml_attack_expired_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_saml_attack_expired_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past); freshness/expiry enforcement failed.
